title: VIXEN full build can exceed the queue memory cap on its final link step
body: The queued ./build-wsl.sh Release run reached 1302/1303, then the queue killed it at 32173 MB against a 32170 MB cap (log /home/liory/.local/state/undertow/undertow-box-logs/1792518176-build-cx-vixroot:vixen-base-build.log). An incremental queued retry completed 225/225. Teach VIXEN build admission/link scheduling to reserve enough memory so a clean full build does not require a manual retry.

title: Standalone renderer mode needs a generated Text interface owned by VIXEN
body: The no-Undertow configure failed because VIXEN/libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt required UNDERTOW_ROOT/transpiled/textshader even in renderer-provider mode (log /home/liory/.local/state/undertow/undertow-box-logs/1792519917-build-cx-vixroot:vixen-no-undertow-configure.log). This lane had to check in the current byte-identical Text.g.h/text.g.glsl snapshot and manually select it in provider mode. Consolidate Text's schema/interface declaration into a VIXEN-owned generator contract so standalone builds do not depend on a copied consumer artifact.

title: Pinned kernel CodegenTool materialization emits 26 invalid-locale warnings
body: Every fresh VIXEN kernel pin materialization builds CodegenTool and emits 26 NETSDK1188 warnings for Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Common/CSharp 4.8.0 locale resources (for example cx-vixroot:vixen-schema-identity-refresh). The tool still succeeds, but the warning storm obscures new warnings and repeats for each pin. Normalize/suppress this known package warning in the pinned materializer while preserving zero-new-warning enforcement for project code.

title: Kernel test-suite launcher is absent from the documented kernel tools path
body: Running the documented bare command tools/check-kernel-test-suite.sh from the kernel worktree failed with exit 127 because that file exists only in the paired Undertow tree. The working route was /home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/pair-cx-vixroot/tools/check-kernel-test-suite.sh --kernel-root <kernel> --undertow-root <pair>. Provide a kernel-root launcher or document the paired-Undertow path so lanes do not need a failed discovery attempt.
